category: Academic medical centers & med school SURPs

programs.name: Summer Research Training Program (SRTP)
programs.focus: Biomedical research at UCSF with structured mentoring and a final symposium.

eligibility.notes: At least four semesters done before the program, no bachelor's degree by spring 2027, and a real interest in a UCSF PhD.

programs.fit_note: Eligibility asks for a desire to pursue a PhD in one of UCSF's graduate disciplines, so apply only if you are leaning MD-PhD. If you are, the Neuroscience and the Epidemiology and Translational Research disciplines sit closest to your work.
programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: opened Nov 1, 2026 and closes Feb 1, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific, which is 2:59 a.m. Eastern on Feb 2. Decisions the first week of March.
programs.stipend_note: Total package over $15,000 including stipend, housing, travel and health insurance

programs.name: Vanderbilt Summer Science Academy (VSSA)
programs.focus: Umbrella for many Vanderbilt summer research tracks including neuroscience, cancer biology and immunology.
programs.stipend_note: Stipend plus housing and travel for most tracks
programs.fit_note: Pick its clinical research internship: it is designed for students headed into medicine and pairs a mentored research project with observing residents and attending physicians. Your lab work and EMT hours speak to both halves.
programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: opened Nov 1, 2026. Track deadlines run Jan 16 to Feb 15, 2027 and most are Feb 1, so the date shown is the earliest. Check your track's own date. One portal, many tracks.
programs.program_dates: Jun 1 - Jul 30, 2027 for most tracks, some to Aug 6, 2027

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF)
programs.focus: Ten weeks of biomedical research at a top-funded medical center.

eligibility.notes: US citizens or F-1 students in a science degree who have finished freshman year. No courses, job or vacation during the ten weeks.

programs.fit_note: Selection weighs PhD or MD-PhD career goals, and fellows plan and run their own experiments in a faculty lab, so it only makes sense if MD-PhD becomes real for you. Neuroscience is one of the listed research areas.
programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: opened Nov 1, 2026 and due Feb 1, 2027. About 50 fellows; neuroscience is one of the research areas. Built for students aiming at a PhD or MD-PhD. Unofficial transcripts are fine.
programs.stipend_note: $5,000, with housing covered if you need it; travel is yours

programs.name: BioMedRAP: Biomedical Research Apprenticeship Program
programs.focus: Nine weeks of biomedical research with graduate-school preparation at WashU Medical School.
programs.fit_note: WashU's biomedical sciences division lists only a summer fellowship for its own students and Amgen Scholars, with no sign of this program. Amgen there wants a strong interest in a PhD or MD-PhD, so it only fits you on the MD-PhD path.
programs.notes: WashU is also an Amgen Scholars host.

programs.name: Summer Research Opportunity Program (SROP)
programs.focus: Research across Michigan's schools with graduate-school preparation.
programs.stipend_note: $5,000 including domestic travel, plus room and board

eligibility.notes: Entering junior or senior year at a school other than Michigan. The page also lists broadening-participation criteria, such as mentoring, tutoring or outreach work, or being first generation; read them before you apply.

programs.fit_note: Michigan's graduate school runs it to prepare students for graduate study, so it pays off mainly if MD-PhD wins out. Research spans the university's schools, neuroscience included, but check its broadening-participation criteria first.
programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: opened Nov 16, 2026 and closes Feb 1, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. EST. Decisions by Apr 5. Information workshops Wednesday, Dec 2 and Tuesday, Jan 12 at 7 p.m. EST.
programs.link_note: This site blocks automated link checks, so the watcher cannot verify it. Open it in a browser.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Experience (SURE)
programs.focus: Ten weeks of mentored research at Emory, with strong pediatric ties through Children's Healthcare of Atlanta.
programs.fit_note: Only current Emory undergraduates who return to Emory in the fall can apply, so it's closed to you. Outside students can only try its partner programs, such as LGS-SOAR, which set their own rules.
programs.notes: Emory's affiliation with Children's Healthcare of Atlanta makes this a back door into pediatric research.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Program (SURP)
programs.org: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai
programs.focus: Ten weeks of biomedical research in Mount Sinai labs.
programs.fit_note: It serves students with limited access to hands-on research, which your Penn State lab already gives you, and it takes only future PhD and MD-PhD applicants. Unless MD-PhD becomes the plan, put this application elsewhere.
programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: open since Oct 1, 2026 and closes Jan 15, 2027. This is SURP4US, for students who are socioeconomically disadvantaged or have limited access to research, and it is for future PhD and MD-PhD applicants only. Read that before you spend time on it.
programs.link_note: This site blocks automated link checks, so the watcher cannot verify it. Open it in a browser.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Program (SURP)
programs.focus: Ten weeks of bench research with a final poster session.
programs.fit_note: Expect bench research that ends in a poster session, which would give you a first poster, though little of your clinical work carries over. Aim for a neuroscience lab, the closest match to your interests here.
programs.notes: Less saturated than the Manhattan programs while still being a strong NYC medical school.
programs.link_note: This site blocks automated link checks, so the watcher cannot verify it. Open it in a browser.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Program
programs.focus: Translational research at a major clinical research institute.
programs.fit_note: The formal internship you could apply to is built around AI, quantum concepts and high-performance computing, far from your human-subjects and clinical work. The other route is emailing a lab yourself, and no housing is provided.
programs.notes: Third Cleveland option alongside the two Case Western programs, one city, three applications.

programs.name: Summer Premedical Academic Enrichment / research programs
programs.org: University of Pittsburgh School of Medicine
programs.focus: Research and premedical enrichment tracks at Pitt Med.
programs.fit_note: The linked page is the medical school's home page and names no summer program. Search the site for emergency medicine's summer research and clinical immersion, where your EMT work counts, or aim your Pittsburgh effort at the Children's Hospital listing.
programs.notes: Pairs with UPMC Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, also on your list, same city, two applications.

programs.name: Summer Scholars Program
programs.focus: Ten weeks of biomedical research with a notably strong neuroscience department.
programs.fit_note: You name up to three potential mentors from lists that include Neuroscience and Translational Biomedical Science, so pick labs that study people, where your participant sessions count. The MSTP track is for students interested in MD-PhD, your open question.
programs.notes: The 2027 application is open now. Nine weeks. The neuroscience track, NEUROCITY, is aimed at CUNY students and schools with little research infrastructure, so the general Summer Scholars track is your route in.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Program
programs.org: UNC Chapel Hill School of Medicine
programs.focus: Biomedical research at UNC with graduate-school preparation.
programs.fit_note: The linked page is UNC's umbrella for PhD students and lists no summer program, and the School of Medicine's own summer REU says it isn't recruiting. If you want UNC, check its Amgen Scholars site instead.
programs.notes: Also an Amgen Scholars host site.

programs.name: Duke Summer Research Opportunity Program (SROP)
programs.focus: Research placements across Duke including a well-regarded neuroscience track.
programs.stipend_note: Competitive stipend plus shared on-campus housing and travel help; no figure posted
programs.fit_note: It's built for students seriously considering a PhD, and most of the summer is hands-on lab work, so it fits only if MD-PhD firms up. If you apply, lead with the lab, where you already troubleshoot protocols, and say you are weighing MD-PhD.
programs.notes: The program was not held in 2026, and the page still says to check back in fall 2026 for summer 2027. Nothing is posted yet. Nine weeks of biomedical research, shared on-campus housing, travel help and a stipend, aimed at students considering a PhD.

programs.name: Equity Summer Research Program
programs.focus: Ten weeks of biomedical research at Oregon's academic health center.
programs.fit_note: Read its eligibility list first, since it is narrower than most, and search OHSU's site for it, as the link opens the medical school's home page. If you qualify, there is a Medicine track, and some assignments are remote, so you might work from home.
programs.notes: Pairs with Doernbecher Children's Hospital for a pediatric angle.

programs.name: Medical Neuroscience Summer Undergraduate Research Program
programs.focus: Neuroscience lab research at the Stark Neurosciences Research Institute, built to prepare you for graduate school.

eligibility.notes: You must still be an enrolled undergraduate that summer.

programs.fit_note: After admission you choose from an open lab list, and neuropsychiatric disorders and neurodevelopment are among the research areas, so aim for the lab closest to your mood research. Expect basic and translational lab science that is new to you.
programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: open since Oct 1, 2026 and due Jan 15, 2027 with all materials. INSPIRE runs alongside it at the same institute, so ask mneuro@iu.edu about being considered for both.
programs.stipend_note: Competitive stipend; the page does not state an amount

programs.name: Summer Research Opportunities
programs.org: Wake Forest University School of Medicine / Atrium Health
programs.focus: Biomedical research with notable strength in aging and Alzheimer's disease.
programs.fit_note: Aging and Alzheimer's are the listed strength, far from your pediatric focus, and the link lands on a general education page. Look instead for the pediatrics department's child health research training, and ask if its school-year part works from Penn State.
programs.notes: Wake Forest runs a major Alzheimer's Disease Research Center, relevant given the INSPIRE interest.

programs.name: Summer in Biomedical Science (SIBS)
programs.focus: Ten weeks of biomedical research with graduate-school preparation.
programs.fit_note: Open to students with no research access on their own campus, and your Penn State lab puts you outside that. The work is lab-based too, a step away from the human-subjects skills you would bring.
programs.notes: Realistic admit odds with a solid research institution behind it. UAB also has Children's of Alabama next door.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF)
programs.focus: Ten weeks of chemistry and molecular biology research at a pure-research institute.
programs.fit_note: Chemistry and molecular biology are the core here, far from your human-subjects and clinical work. The Translational Institute's separate summer program, geared toward health sciences, statistics and computing, sits closer to medicine.
programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: open now, and everything is due Feb 1 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific, which is 2:59 a.m. Eastern on Feb 2. Prior research is not required, and the program encourages students with limited research access at home. Two letters, an unofficial transcript, a CV and a two page statement. The Florida campus runs a separate application.
programs.stipend_note: Stipend and housing for every participant; amount not posted on the overview

programs.name: Summer Student Internship
programs.focus: Research in neurodegeneration (notably Parkinson's) and cancer epigenetics.
programs.fit_note: Interns work in basic science labs on the cellular and molecular roots of disease, with Parkinson's as the neuro angle. It's set up as an introduction to bench research, but your human-subjects and clinical work won't carry over much.
programs.notes: Strong neurodegeneration focus and much less well known than the coastal institutes, so better odds.

programs.name: Undergraduate Clinical Scholars Program (UCSP)
programs.org: Perelman School of Medicine, University of Pennsylvania
programs.focus: Nine weeks on a clinical research project with an expert clinical investigator, plus weekly lectures and statistics workshops in epidemiology and biostatistics. Built for students aiming at an MD, PhD or MD-PhD.
programs.stipend_note: Competitive stipend, amount not posted; housing is yours to find
programs.program_dates: Early June to end of July 2027, exact dates not set

eligibility.notes: Open to students from any accredited US school, with preference for students who are not graduating. You must be eligible to work in the US.

programs.fit_note: You would do clinical research under an expert clinical investigator, and future MDs are welcome. Your mentor picks the project, so flag pediatrics as your interest, and lead with the lab and your Good Clinical Practice training.
programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: the 2027 application is open now and must be submitted online by Friday, Jan 8, 2027 at 5 p.m. EST. Transcripts and letters must be sent or postmarked by Friday, Jan 15 at 5 p.m. EST. One letter from a professor, and if you have done research, one from your research mentor. Selected applicants interview. Clinical research, which is rare among these programs.
